_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Simplest interior RP spec. Context prefix CSRP (CloSet RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. CLRP is ceiling RP. Verified: zero TSK_CSRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use. QT2-QT3 only, brush_roll only.

paintable_items.name: Closet shelf opening (S/M/L/XL tier)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC. Same physical item in RP context. Opening count quantification by tier (S/M/L/XL) transfers unchanged from NC.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_CLOSET_* is NC closet shelf (generic prefix). TSK_CSRP_* is unique for closet shelf RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — CSRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_CSRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. All tasks in this RP spec use the CSRP_ prefix. NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_CSRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Floor protection under closet opening. Minimal — one zone (floor_workzone) only.

RP-specific: brief visual condition scan per closet. Single combined task — no separate adhesion/coating-ID subtasks. Maps to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase in controlled_enums. FIXED time task.
Degloss/scuff, scrape/feather (conditional), mildew treatment (conditional), spot fill, caulk repair. Simple tasks for utility surfaces.
State-driven primer: adhesion (failing/peeling), stain-block (moisture/smoke), or generic brush prime. Conditional on substrate_state. No primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.
Finish coat brush/roll. QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats. No interstage — QT2/QT3 closet shelving does not warrant interstage sanding.
Protection teardown, final inspection, brief customer walkthrough.
Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec.

paintscope_keys.description: Small openings count (6-18" x 6-18"). Drives per-opening tasks.
Medium openings count (18-36" x 12-30"). Drives per-opening tasks.
Large openings count (36-60" x 18-42"). Drives per-opening tasks.
XL openings count (60"+ x 30"+). Drives per-opening tasks.
Detail modifier: SIMPLE_BOX / FACE_FRAME / CROWN_VALANCE / BEADED_ROUTED.
Floor protection area under closet opening.
Interior substrate state classification. Drives primer selection and conditional task activation.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with other interior RP specs (proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP).

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all interior RP specs.

quality_tier.notes: QT4/QT5 excluded — closet shelving is utility-grade surface. QT2=0.85x (economy, 1 finish coat), QT3=1.0x (standard, 2 finish coats).

application_method.notes: Spray not justified for closet shelving RP — small scope, enclosed space, utility surface. Brush_roll only.

sheen.notes: Flat is default for closet shelving. Eggshell for slight washability. Satin included per U-001 resolution for visible walk-in closets/pantries.

phase.notes: No interstage phase — QT2/QT3 do not require interstage sanding for closet shelving.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA_OPENING for per-opening tasks (tier S/M/L/XL). EA_CLOSET for per-closet tasks (floor protect, walkthrough). FIXED for assessment.

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Most common: SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT. Second most common: SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE (bathroom/basement closets).

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep intensity: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.3x, POOR=2.0x.

product_role.notes: Simple spec — no sealer, no specialty. Primers are state-driven RP primers. Finish is standard acrylic enamel.

protection_level.notes: Minimal protection — one zone (floor_workzone), edge_only level. No wall masking, no hardware (shelves have no hardware).

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT2=baseline_reduction (0.85x). No selective_multiplier or additional_rounds needed — only 2 tiers.

surface_ids.notes: Both surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json. builtin_shelf: shelf surfaces. wall_field: closet walls (not in scope, but adjacent).

zone_ids.notes: Drop cloth under closet opening. Always required (RP always has finished floors).

material_system_prefix.notes: Three shared RP primer systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew) are reused from wall RP. SYS_CLOSET_SHELF_STANDARD from NC is the finish system for QT2-QT3 closet shelving. No premium urethane system needed — QT4/QT5 excluded. No new material systems anticipated.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Chemical degloss for existing paint. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific surface wash. Proposed in SF_DOOR_INT_RP resolution.

proposed_consumables.name: Mildewcide / Biocide Solution
proposed_consumables.justification: Mildew treatment for SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE closets. Primary RP-specific remediation consumable for closets.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 1 finish coat. QT2 economy with primer needed.
1 finish coat only. QT2 economy, sound paint, no prime needed.
State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. QT3 standard with primer needed.
2 finish coats only. QT3 standard, sound paint, no prime needed.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for RP primer on previously painted closet shelf surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less than bare wood. Expect 350-400 SF/gal equivalent.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for standard acrylic enamel on repainted closet shelf surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC coverage — 400 SF/gal. Previously painted surfaces may have slightly better coverage.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared per instruction. Drives prep intensity: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.3x, POOR=2.0x.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC unchanged. SHALLOW=1.0, DEEP=1.15, VERY_DEEP=1.30.
Transfers from NC unchanged. SIMPLE_BOX=1.0, FACE_FRAME=1.20, CROWN_VALANCE=1.35, BEADED_ROUTED=1.50.
Transfers from NC unchanged. OPEN_ACCESS=1.0, CRAMPED=1.25, OBSTRUCTED=1.50.

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x depth x detail x access
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x VERY_DEEP(1.30) x BEADED_ROUTED(1.50) x OBSTRUCTED(1.50) = 5.85x
prep_pool.flag_note: Exceeds 4.0x. However POOR + VERY_DEEP + BEADED_ROUTED + OBSTRUCTED is extremely rare. Realistic max: FAIR(1.3) x DEEP(1.15) x FACE_FRAME(1.20) x CRAMPED(1.25) = 2.24x.

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x depth x detail x access
coating_pool.max_theoretical: QT3(1.0) x VERY_DEEP(1.30) x BEADED_ROUTED(1.50) x OBSTRUCTED(1.50) = 2.93x

coordination_notes: Closet shelf RP does NOT overlap with closet wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP), closet ceiling RP (SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP), closet door RP (SF_DOOR_INT_RP), or closet trim RP (SF_TRIM_INT_RP). Each is a separate spec with separate scope.

Floor protection (floor_workzone) may already be in place from closet wall RP — but closet shelving protection footprint is typically different (directly under shelf openings, not full floor). No deduplication needed.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums
